# Static Handout Print Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Add print/PDF handout support for generated static reader and discovery pages.

**Architecture:** Implement this as print-only CSS in the existing local rich stylesheet generated by `packages/static/src/raya_static/rendering.py`. Keep all behavior static and local; tests inspect generated CSS and browser print emulation.

**Tech Stack:** Python 3.10, pytest, Playwright/Chromium, generated static HTML/CSS.

---

**Files:**
- Modify: `tests/contracts/test_static_builder.py`
- Modify: `packages/static/src/raya_static/rendering.py`

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the failing CSS contract test**

Add a test that builds `examples/courses/render-fixture`, reads `artifact/site/_raya/render/rich.css`, and asserts:

```python
assert "@media print" in rich_css
assert ".raya-top-command-bar" in rich_css
assert ".raya-course-map" in rich_css
assert ".raya-learning-rail" in rich_css
assert ".raya-main-article" in rich_css
assert "page-break-inside: avoid" in rich_css
assert "content: \" (\" attr(href) \")\"" in rich_css
```

- [ ] **Step 2: Run test to verify it fails**

Run:

```bash
UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT=.venv-local uv run pytest tests/contracts/test_static_builder.py::test_build_copies_static_render_resources -q
```

Expected: FAIL because the stylesheet has no print media rules.

assert page.locator(".raya-main-article").is_visible()
